name: Viviana Albani
researchKeywords: quantitative health inequalities, vulnerable populations, children and older people, diet and health
bio: Viviana is a Senior Research Associate who applies quantitative methods in describing, understanding, and identifying mechanisms to reduce regional and social health inequalities. She conducts work on the impact of social and economic policies on health inequalities. Her other research interest lies in the food environment, diet and health.
researchFocus: Research themes: Political economy of health, health and place, public health nutrition

researchActivity.projectTitle: Investigating the health inequalities impact of national policies aiming to promote local economic growth in disadvantaged places.
otherCollaborators: Katie Fahy (co-lead), John Wildman, Dan Holman, Ben Barr, Jennie Popay
